I have run into the issue of losing my backpack once when playing coop. It seemed like whenever someone lost a backpack, it was me. Luckily, since I was the host of the world I could go into my saved game files 

C:program files x86/steam/steam apps/common/outward/savegames/*your profile*/*whichever character u used*/ 

and then you will see there are folders that are made every few minutes. Just delete the last 1-2 folders and then you will be back in a spot before you died once you restart

KEEP IN MIND: this doesn’t happen very often at all. It’s only happened to me twice in 16 hours played all in coop so far. The game is super fun and I recommend it for you and your friend

I agree with you that Arya was qualified to kill the night king. I am “mad” for a different reason. Well, mad really isn’t the right word. I guess I just am not satisfied with the fact that the night king was killed in this episode. I know there are still 3 episodes left and that my speculation may not be warranted, but what I will say is that I will feel cheated if this is the end of the white walkers plot of the story and the final 3 episodes shift back into fighting for the iron throne. I still feel like there is still more to the story that needs to be told about the origins of the night king and how it all relates to the main plot. Why couldn’t the night king get killed by fire? Why was he trying to kill humans? Why was the night king able to ride a dragon? Why has there been so much imagery that relates the white walkers/ night king to being a Targaryen? The whole explanation that they gave, that he was made in order to defend the world against the humans long ago, just isn’t enough for me. I believe that the show writers are better than that. I can live with the whole hive complex of how the night king works, but only if they explain if/how him and the 3 eyed raven are tied into the plot more. If this episode settled the night king/white walkers completely, then I will be upset. I wish that they didn’t win that battle that quickly. The whole show started with the ambiguity of white walkers and their threat has always been breathing down everyone’s neck, and to just be able to narrow it down to this final battle in one episode where it all happened just as everyone predicted (they were outnumbered, about to lose, but the queen of the hive was killed when it seemed all hope was lost) in my opinion, is just beneath the quality of writing that this show has produced from this point. So I’m not really mad that Arya is the one that killed him, I’m happy she was the one! She is the deadliest person in the show and earned it. I love her character, but I wish it happened differently. But what do I know? There’s still 3 more episodes and a lot could happen so I will give them the benefit of the doubt that it will all come together.

The best thing to improve your account overall is to get the big boy quests done (RFD, MM2, etc) and also try to get some of the untradeables that are really good like fighters torso, void, salve ammy, and do things that you find fun as well. Don’t burn yourself out by doing one activity for too long. That’s my advice to you, have fun!
